The old comment claimed to be following "the same default every committed
transcript depends on" -- a claim that silently became false when you moved the

between a comment that can rot and one that cannot, and you did not have to be

THE THREE THINGS. All three look like the SAME cause -- the subject moved from
the marine flagship to a land settlement -- and your diff says so in only one of
the three places:

  1. driver.rs:4931   `t.starts_with("Vngashngatva")`  ->  `t != NOTHING_HERE_YET`
     You re-MEASURED everywhere else (308 -> 423, and the 874+103+ arithmetic
     with it) and here you dropped to "not the placeholder". The name almost
     certainly just changed with the subject; pinning the NEW name keeps the
     assertion's strength. As written it would pass on any string at all,
     including a different settlement's.

  2. `here.latitude.abs() < 10.0`  ->  `< mercator::LAT_CLAMP_DEG`
     That is 10 degrees to 85. The old bound asserted "seed 42's flagship is
     equatorial (measured -4.0028)", which your change makes false and which
     was incidental to what that test proves -- so replacing it is defensible
     and arguably more correct. But 85 degrees excludes almost nothing, so the
     precondition now has little power; if it is meant to have none, say that.

  3. `excluded, 99` -> `excluded, 1`
     You updated the doc figure, which is what the assertion's own message
     asks for. But that message also says "re-measure, do not just paste the
     new number", and the doc around it says this golden moves on "a terrain
     epoch, a site-roster change ... every one of which is a change somebody
     should look at". A drop of 98 is such a change. It is very likely just the
     subject moving off the water -- at a marine flagship nearly every
     point-site is excluded, at a land settlement almost none -- but that
     sentence is not anywhere in the diff.

ONE SENTENCE IN THE CHRONICLE COVERS ALL THREE: that the seed-42 client subject
moved from the ledger-first (now marine) settlement to the authored land
settlement, and that the name, the latitude precondition and the exclusion count
all follow from that single change. Without it, a reader six months from now
meets three separately-weakened assertions and no common cause.

I AM NOT HOLDING YOU. Your gate is 6328/6328, this is your sixth slot, and (1)
and (2) are judgement calls a reasonable reviewer could make either way -- they
are not wrong, they are unexplained. Fold the sentence into your close.
